pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A short-lived hypnotic (half-life about 2.5 hours) with a boxed warning for sleep-driving and other complex sleep behaviors.

clues.text: Food reduces exposure, so it should not be taken with or right after a meal for faster sleep onset. About 92.5% is bound to protein, and it is converted to inactive metabolites eliminated mainly by the kidneys.
A tartrate salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 307.4. It is sparingly soluble in water.
An NDA tablet in 5 and 10 mg strengths, taken nightly.

Boxed warning for complex sleep behaviors such as sleep-walking and sleep-driving. Contraindicated after complex sleep behaviors or known hypersensitivity; daytime drowsiness and dizziness are most commonly reported.
Short-term treatment of insomnia characterized by difficulty initiating sleep.
It is a GABA-A receptor positive modulator, binding the benzodiazepine site of α1 subunit receptors and increasing chloride channel opening.
The generic name begins with Z and has eight letters.
